scope: Live external Gemini candidate source/log review; no causal intervention or independent capability validation
findings: Predictor takes only normalized motor latents, not token embedding; useful removal of previous explicit token-to-predictor bypass.
Actual teacher models 14 quiet zero-external-drive continuations of complete state; auxiliary supervise only window-final anchor.
Current student anchor input at rollout hop k mixes already-k-step teacher latent before another transition; its resulting k-labeled output is compared to k-step teacher.

Main CE head consumes teacher-mixed anchor rollout during training/active learner, whereas predict_fly_next uses no teacher. Future token labels are not provided by quiet teacher, but this creates an additional-physical-computation/training-generation discrepancy.
768-dimensional single normalized motor observation need not be sufficient for autonomous full-state dynamics: hidden ring/ge/gi/ALIF/STP may differ at identical motor z.
SIGReg regularizes attended decoder readout rather than every raw encoder representation or all physical trajectory endpoints.
Existing graphs are explicitly disabled when use_latent_predictor is enabled; measured current speed is eager.
decision: Treat as promising motor-response model candidate with observed same-stream marginal gain. Prioritize autonomous teacher-free student CE and correct temporal transition supervision before attributing delay compensation; preserve ongoing external run. No new training approval issued.
